items.description:
The UK’s left-wing Green Party on Sunday voted to define Zionism as racism at the party’s annual get-together, drawing sharp backlash from British Jewish groups and the Israeli government.

Every month, Idrees sends money home from Dammam in Saudi Arabia. items.title: Security forces kill 3 terrorists in DI Khan IBO: state media
items.description:
Security forces on Monday killed three terrorists during an intelligence-based operation in the Dera Ismail Khan district of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, state media reported on Monday.
President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif commended the security forces for conducting the security operation.
In separate statements, President Zardari said effective operations by the security forces were playing an important role in weakening terrorist networks, adding that the “nefarious designs” of terrorist elements operating with external support would be thwarted at all costs.

items.title: Rawalpindi traders fear road closures as PTI’s long march looms
items.description:

items.title: Bangladesh’s rivers of ‘plastic’
items.description:
The use of single-use plastic started in Bangladesh in the 1980s. In about half a century, the Buriganga, Dhaka’s lifeline, has become choked with plastic waste.
The country generates around 3,000 tonnes of plastic waste every day, according to a 2022 study by the Environment and Social Development Organisation (ESDO). Experts say production has since increased significantly.
